claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_modifier family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. The trait is passive and always-on — no activation cost, no use-count resource, no reset cadence. No existing family (activation, on_hit_trigger, ongoing_effect, etc.) can represent this honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage as a passive species-trait effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists but is only wired into MasteryEffect (on-hit riders). A passive_modifier family for species traits would need a SpeciesTraitEffect variant that expresses unconditional advantage on a closed set of saving-throw ability scores, attached to self with no window or resolution intermediary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
